activity_heatmap_hint: When windows are captured — weekday × hour of day, cell intensity ∝ count.
affect_empty: No windows in the current selection. Affect appears once emotion windows have been captured — run a capture (or widen the filters), then refresh.
affect_over_time_hint: Daily mean valence & arousal (−1…+1). Gaps mark days where a dimension was not measured.
affect_plane_hint: Valence × arousal — recent windows fade into a trail (newest is the halo dot).
affect_plane_hint_capped: Valence × arousal — recent windows fade into a trail (newest is the halo dot; last {cap} of {total} shown).
affect_v2_empty_detail: Affect appears once Oyon emotion windows have been captured.
affect_v2_empty_text: No affect windows in the current selection.
affect_v2_no_dynamics: No dynamics yet. This needs at least two consecutive windows with valence/arousal.
anxious_title: Derived anxiety indicator {value} (high arousal + negative valence + fear)
aoi_tooltip: {label}: {share} of gaze time · {dwell} dwell · {count, plural, one {# window} other {# windows}}
attention_by_emotion_hint: Mean attention signals across the windows each emotion labels.
attention_not_enough_timeline: Not enough engagement data for a timeline.
attention_single_session_only: Filter to a single session to see the focus timeline.
attention_targets_hint: Share of gaze-window time dwelling on each on-screen target. AOIs are used when present; windows without AOI dwell fall back to their dominant screen zone.
attention_v2_empty_detail: Engagement appears after Oyon capture windows include focus, eye, and gaze quality signals.
attention_v2_empty_text: No engagement data in the current selection.
attention_v2_no_lapse_signal: No off-screen or missing-face signal in these windows.
attention_v2_not_enough_line: Not enough sequential engagement windows for a line view.
attention_v2_subtitle: Focus, eye openness, off-screen gaze, and signal quality for the current filters.
capture_timeline_hint: Dominant expression per window — bar color is the emotion, bar height its probability. Newest on the right.
card_note: Analysis runs locally in your browser; recordings are only stored with your consent ({version}). You can stop capture at any time from the camera pill, and change this choice under Settings → Oyon.
card_toggle: Allow camera-based emotion capture during my sessions
cases_empty: No cases match the current filters.
centroid_tooltip: x {x} · y {y} · {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
co_emotions_none: No estimated emotions in this selection yet.
co_emotions_single: No co-occurring emotions yet — only one emotion, or one person, is present. Widen the filters.
compare_empty: No windows in the current selection. Comparisons appear once emotion windows have been captured — run a capture (or widen the filters), then refresh.
compare_mode_entities: Comparing {count} {entity, select, student {{count, plural, one {student} other {students}}} case {{count, plural, one {case} other {cases}}} other {{count, plural, one {session} other {sessions}}}}
compare_mode_slices: Single session — split into {count, plural, one {# time slice} other {# time slices}}
compare_not_enough: Not enough to compare — at least two {entity, select, student {students} case {cases} other {sessions}} (or two windows in one session) are needed. Try another compare-by dimension or widen the filters.
compare_timelines_capped: Showing the {cap} most recent groups; the table above lists all {total}.
compare_timelines_hint: Dominant expression per window, per group — bar height is the dominant probability, newest right.
compare_total_windows: {count, plural, one {# window} other {# windows}} total
dashboard_load_failed: Could not load the Oyon dashboard
dashboard_truncated: capped at the most recent 1000 windows
dashboards_caption: Oyon dashboards over the records matching the current filters. Estimates from visible facial signals only, aggregated in ~10 s windows.
dashboards_caption_refreshing: Oyon dashboards over the records matching the current filters — refreshing…. Estimates from visible facial signals only, aggregated in ~10 s windows.
dashboards_failed_default: Could not load the Oyon dashboards
dashboards_failed_hint: Check that the Oyon add-on assets are reachable (they are served from /oyon/standalone by the Rohy backend), then use Refresh above or reload the page to retry.
dashboards_failed_title: The Oyon analytics viewer failed to load
dynamics_none: No dynamics — needs at least two consecutive windows with valence/arousal.
dynamics_timeline_hint: Affect speed and instability per window (clamped to 0–1, the element's scale). Gaps mark windows where a signal could not be derived.
emotion_distribution_hint: Count of windows per dominant expression (top 10).
engagement_empty: No engagement data in the current selection. Engagement arrives with windows captured by the v2 pill (mediapipe engine, on by default) — run a capture, then refresh.
engagement_no_data_windows: No engagement data in these windows.
engagement_over_time_hint: Focus + eye openness per window, and the attention-lapse strip (off-screen / no face).
focus_openness_hint: Per-window focus score and eye openness (0–1). Gaps mean no engagement block for that window.
focus_openness_multi_session: Windows from {count} sessions are concatenated chronologically — filter to a single session for a true timeline (the Attention tab adds the lapse strip there).
gaze_centroids_hint: Per-window centroid on a screen-shaped canvas (dot size ∝ √points). Aggregates only — never a raw point stream.
gaze_empty: No gaze data in the current selection. Gaze arrives with windows captured by the v2 pill (mediapipe engine, on by default) — run a capture, then refresh.
gaze_maps_hint: Each grid sits over a miniature of that screen, so a zone reads as the part of the room it covers.
gaze_no_aoi_dwell: No AOI dwell data yet — captured by the v2 pill while a target is on screen.
gazelog_csv_title: Download the currently listed gaze rows as CSV (all gaze fields)
gazelog_empty: No gaze windows match the current filters.
heat_bucket_tooltip: {emotion} · bucket {bucket}: {count, plural, one {# window} other {# windows}}
hint_affect_speed: Velocity across the valence–arousal plane at the newest window (units/s).
hint_at_patient: Share of window time gazing toward the patient's face region, over the {count} windows where the patient was on screen. No patient on screen ≠ not looking.
hint_avg_arousal: Mean arousal over all windows with a measured value (−1 calm … +1 activated).
hint_avg_valence: Mean valence over all windows with a measured value (−1 negative … +1 positive).
hint_calibration: No-face: {value} of window time had no detectable face.
hint_focus_none: No focus data in these windows.
hint_instability: 0–1 composite of affect speed, volatility, entropy, missingness and label switching.
hint_latest_quality: 1 − missing-face ratio of the newest window.
hint_mean_entropy: Mean gaze entropy — higher means gaze scattered over more of the screen.
hint_mean_openness: Mean eye-openness (0–1) over the windows that carry it.
hint_off_screen: Share of tracked gaze pointing away from the screen.
load_failed: Could not load the Oyon capture element
local_only: Local capture only — backend rejected writes
open_analytics: Open Learning Analytics (Settings → Oyon — Learning Analytics)
plane_no_samples: No valence/arousal samples in these windows.
plane_no_samples_va: No valence/arousal samples in these windows — the capture model may not emit V/A.
reconsent_body: You previously agreed to camera-based emotion capture. Your institution now also wants to record how you work during a session. These are new kinds of information, so we are asking rather than assuming.
reconsent_decline: No, keep it as it is
reconsent_item_discourse: The style of the messages you send, such as whether you are asking or explaining.
reconsent_item_interaction: How you move around the screen — clicks, scrolling and which panel has your attention.
reconsent_item_typing: Typing rhythm in the message box — pauses and bursts, never the words you write.
reconsent_note: Analysis runs locally in your browser and only summaries are stored ({version}). Saying no keeps your existing emotion-capture choice exactly as it is, and you can change either one under Settings → Oyon.
reconsent_title: We need to ask again about capture
screen_zones_hint: Point-weighted share of gaze per screen ninth.
session_no_windows: No estimated-expression windows captured for this session.
session_note: Oyon-only timeline. Each row carries session_id, user_id, and case_id — combine with Rohy's session log offline (export → join) for behaviour-aligned analyses.
sessions_empty: No sessions match the current filters.
sessions_summary: {windows, plural, one {# window} other {# windows}} across {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}
strip_windows_shown_capped: {count, plural, one {# window} other {# windows}} (newest of {total})
students_empty: No students match the current filters.
trends_empty: No windows in the current selection. Trends appear once emotion windows have been captured — run a capture (or widen the filters), then refresh.
window_no_probabilities: no probabilities recorded for this window
windows_empty: No windows match the current quality filters.
windows_filtered_count: {filtered} of {total, plural, one {# window} other {# windows}}
windows_with_engagement: {count}/{total, plural, one {# window} other {# windows}} with engagement
